Capture it with your iPhone.
We make it a walkthrough.

Walk the space with the Veylet app on a recent iPhone Pro. We process the capture, check it, host it and hand you a reviewed 3D walkthrough with a private link and a website embed. No camera to buy, no course, and nobody sees it before you approve it.

Pilot status. We are onboarding early accounts while our own captures are still under quality review; we have no client-accepted tour to show yet. The studio confirms the private transfer route and checks the capture. A capture that is not good enough is never counted.

What counts, and what never costs anything.

An accepted walkthrough
One space, captured with the app, that passed the studio check and that you approved for release. It is the only thing we count.
Four in your free months
Four accepted walkthroughs across the six months in total, not four a month. Use them in one week or spread them over six.
One or three a month
Once the plan starts, Solo includes one accepted walkthrough a month and Team three. Unused ones do not carry over.
Extras
Beyond the four in your free months, or beyond your plan’s monthly allowance, an extra requires your agreement before work begins and settled payment before acceptance: A$89, or A$99.99 in the app once the in-app extra purchase arrives in a later app version.
Larger spaces
One accepted walkthrough uses one allowance unit. The studio agrees the scope of a large or multi-level space before work begins; separately agreed walkthroughs count separately.
Seats
Everyone in your office can capture on the same account. You pay for walkthroughs, not people.
A capture that is not good enough
Never counted. The studio checks the capture and asks for a recapture if needed; that attempt costs nothing.
Hosting
Included while you are with us, and every released walkthrough stays live for twelve months after its release whatever happens to your plan. After that, A$49 a year per walkthrough, only when you ask.
Starting
An eligible App Store introductory offer, or a studio-invoiced trial under written terms, provides six free months of Solo or Team. Extra walkthroughs require your agreement. Activating the plan is what starts the free months; card payment on this website is coming later.
Stopping
Manage an App Store subscription in Settings › Subscriptions. For an invoiced plan, email the studio to cancel; we confirm the end date. Check the next charge or end date in your account. Released walkthroughs keep their agreed hosting term.

Prices are totals in Australian dollars; if GST applies it is included, and your invoice states the exact treatment.

How it works, start to finish.

Any iPhone 12 Pro or later Pro model, or a recent iPad Pro. One email signs in both the app and your desk on this site.

  1. Walk the space with the phone upright and turn at each spot until the ring closes. The app shows route checks; the studio assesses capture quality and confirms the next step.

  2. Finish and check the saved route. In the current app, export the capture to Files or AirDrop for the private transfer we arrange; in-app sending is not enabled yet.

  3. The studio reconstructs the walkthrough and checks rooms, doorways and privacy. Not good enough? We ask for a recapture, and nothing is counted.

  4. Approve the exact version or send one list of corrections; only an approved walkthrough counts. Then copy the link or embed from your desk. Revoking blocks new access immediately.

Apply as a capture partner

Straight answers.

Which phones work?

iPhone 12 Pro and later Pro or Pro Max models, and iPad Pro models with LiDAR, on iOS 17 or later. Standard iPhones without LiDAR are not supported. If you are unsure, tell us the model in your enquiry.

I used my four walkthroughs. Does my trial end?

No. Your original trial end date stays the same. An extra needs a separate, explicit agreement through an available payment route. Choosing a monthly or annual renewal does not add walkthroughs today. The in-app extra purchase is not available yet; existing walkthroughs remain accessible.

What happens when the six free months end?

An App Store subscription renews automatically at the monthly or annual price you selected unless cancelled through Apple. Check the renewal date in Settings › Subscriptions. Studio-invoiced plans continue under your written agreement; email the studio to change or cancel them. If you do stop, every walkthrough you released stays live for twelve months after its release, and your account and records stay yours.

Solo or Team?

Solo suits about one space a month. If you regularly need three a month, Team includes them for A$249 instead of Solo plus two agreed extras. Both plans have the same studio check, review before release, hosting, link and embed.

Why is the App Store price higher?

The App Store and studio invoice channels have different published prices and payment arrangements. Each plan is identical either way, and so is everything the studio does.

We list more than ten a month. Is there an office plan?

Office covers ten accepted walkthroughs a month with priority processing, and it is not self-serve. While the studio still checks every walkthrough by hand we size larger plans one office at a time, and we will say plainly what we can process each month before you rely on it.

What if my capture is not good enough?

The app flags route checks, but these do not prove capture quality. The studio assesses the capture and asks for a recapture if needed; that attempt is not counted. Only a walkthrough you accept counts against your allowance.

Will it appear on realestate.com.au or Domain?

Not yet. REA shows tours only from its supported suppliers, and we are not one. Domain includes its own tour product with some listings. What you get is a link and an embed for your own website, emails, portals that accept a link, and social channels. Tell us the exact destinations you need and we will say plainly which ones work.

Who has to agree to the capture?

Whoever controls the space, and the occupants if it is lived in or worked in. For a rental that means the tenant as well as the owner; for a listing you do not control, the selling agent. Capture permission and permission to publish are separate choices, and the app records both for each space.

What does the privacy check cover?

People, documents, screens, personal photographs and any area you excluded. You see the exact version before release and can ask for anything removed. Revocation stops new access at once; it cannot recall copies someone already downloaded.

Who owns the walkthrough?

You keep the rights to your space and its imagery. Your account states who may share, embed and revoke each walkthrough, how long it is hosted and what we retain. We never publish or use your space in our own marketing without a separate written yes.

Can I see a real customer example first?

Not yet. Our captures are still under quality review and we will not show concept artwork as proof. Ask about the current pilot and we will explain exactly what has been tested.
